answer.reason: In the EIA state electricity profile Table 1, the Electric utilities net generation value is the smaller of the two close figures, with 47,431,447 MWh corresponding to the larger All sectors total. Therefore, the Electric utilities net generation is 46,637,698 MWh.

A. 46,637,698 megawatthours
B. 47,431,447 megawatthours

Source citation: Oklahoma Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/oklahoma/index.php)
